name: Retell AI
tagline: AI voice agents for contact centres that answer, qualify and book on real phone calls.
about: Retell AI is a platform for building and running phone agents. It connects to telephony and business systems and is priced by usage.
pros: Built for phone calls: answering, qualifying and booking.
Pay as you go, with free starting credits.
Connects to telephony and business systems.
cons: Per-minute pricing; cost grows with call volume.
Call flows need careful testing before going live.
